skill_upgrade.crimsoncovenant.crimson_sh: A giant bat's wings for a minute, gliding like an elytra. Right-click while gliding for a Blood Charge: 5 blood to drive you on like a firework, leaving afterimages in your wake (with a bow, crossbow, trident or spear in hand, right-click uses that instead). Glide through a creature to snatch it up, and right-click to drop it (no Blood Charges with your hands full); if the fall kills it, its blood is yours. No fall can hurt you while they're out. Use the skill again to fold them away.
message.crimsoncovenant.crimson_shroud.h: Jump in mid-air to spread your wings. Right-click while gliding for a Blood Charge. Use the skill again to fold them.
effect.crimsoncovenant.hydrophobia.descr: The first stage of rabies: no appetite, and a terror of water. A Potion of Cleanse cures it; left alone, it turns into Rabies.
effect.crimsoncovenant.rabies.descriptio: No potion cures it. The sick foam at the mouth and bite on sight, and die when it runs its course, unless a Totem of Undying or Defy Death cheats that death.

message.crimsoncovenant.iron_maiden.rest: You wake strangely restored, by the life of %s captives

curse.crimsoncovenant.enchain.descriptio: Blows and arrows chain the target where it stands
curse.crimsoncovenant.tracing_shot.descr: Always awake: whatever your arrows strike is marked, and every arrow after hunts it down for as long as it lives
curse.crimsoncovenant.enthrall.descripti: What the weapon kills rises again to fight for you a while
curse.crimsoncovenant.gluttony.descripti: Always awake: kills heal you, but wield it too long without one and it gnaws at your hunger
curse.crimsoncovenant.gust.description: A gale sweeps out before you, and from every blow you land
curse.crimsoncovenant.dragonstrike.descr: Your next arrow becomes two spirit wyrms that tear through everything in their path
curse.crimsoncovenant.weapons.either: Melee weapons, bows, crossbows and tridents

Twenty nights survived: you are an %s vampire, and your powers grow
Thirty nights survived: you are %s. The night itself knows you now
item.crimsoncovenant.whip.hint: Reaches twice as far. Its crack drives foes back, and slams them into walls. Silver bites the undead.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.intro: Every creature of the night you come across is written in here, once you've seen it near enough with your own eyes.
guide.crimsoncovenant.event.blood_moon.t: Some full-moon nights, thirteen days or more apart, the moon rises red. Vampires swarm, those under the open sky are seized by Bloodlust, the night's lords walk abroad, and hunter parties come twice as often.
guide.crimsoncovenant.event.hunter_parti: By night, bands of three hunters roam, led by one who bears a banner. They attack the undead, and anyone tainted by the vampire's curse, on sight.
guide.crimsoncovenant.event.graveyards.t: Walled graveyards stand in grassy and wooded lands. The dead do not rest easy there: by night, things rise among the stones, and some of the stones themselves are not empty.
guide.crimsoncovenant.event.rabies.text: Some wild wolves and foxes, and some of the night's own creatures, are born with Hydrophobia: they will not eat, and they run from water. A Potion of Cleanse cures it. Left a day or so, it turns to Rabies, which no potion cures: the beast foams at the mouth, attacks people on sight and snaps at any animal that comes near, until it dies two days later. Only cheating death will see you through it: a Totem of Undying, or a vampire's Defy Death. Its bite can pass Hydrophobia on, to you, your cat or your dog. A rabid beast put down is worth more experience.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.welcome: A traveller's ledger of the night: who walks in it, how to join them, and what to beware of. It grows as you learn.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.night.1: Two powers wage war in the dark. Vampires feed on the living and grow stronger with every night they survive. The hunters hunt them, with silver, garlic and holy water.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.night.2: You belong to neither, yet. You may join either side, and this ledger will become that side's own book.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.night.3: Whichever you choose, the night holds far more than these two. What you meet, and live to describe, is written in the bestiary.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.night.4: Keep this book: it will be needed.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.vampires.1: The curse is passed in blood. A vampire's kill leaves its victim infected with Sanguine Vampiris; so does drinking a Bottle of Blood.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.vampires.2: Three days later, the infected becomes a vampire. Dying while infected only hastens it: you rise at once.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.vampires.3: A Potion of Cleanse, drunk, can draw the curse out of you, but only before it takes hold. Once turned, there is no going back.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.vampires.4: A vampire never hungers, sees in the dark and grows stronger by night, but burns in the sun, shuns garlic, and fears silver and holy water.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.vampires.5: Turn, and this ledger becomes the Codex Sanguinis.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.hunters.1: Hunter parties walk the night, led by one who carries a banner. Offer the leader a Silver Coin and you are one of them: an Initiate.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.hunters.2: To rise through the ranks (Tracker, Slayer, Warden, Grand Hunter), offer any hunter Tokens of Blood, proof of vampires slain, with silver ingots in your pack. Each rank asks more.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.hunters.3: Each rank opens more of the hunters' gear: silver arrows, bear traps, holy water, silvered weapons, and the hunters' potions.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.hunters.4: Hunters turn away anyone carrying the vampire's curse, and a hunter who becomes a vampire is cast out.
guide.crimsoncovenant.ledger.hunters.5: Hunters may also lay hauntings on their weapons at a Haunted Anvil.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.welcome: The book of the blood. All a vampire must know of its gifts and its banes, and of the skills of the blood, written in as you earn them.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.fledglin: You are newly turned: a fledgling. Survive ten days, and your powers will begin to grow.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.now: Day %s of your unlife: you are %s.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.gift.1: You never hunger: blood is all you need. Your blood bar holds a hundred drops, and more as you grow old, shown in golden drops above it; but only the first thirty come back on their own, the rest you must feed for. Every living creature you kill pours in half its life as blood, healing you a little as it does.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.gift.2: You see in the dark (turn it off and on with its key), you need no air and feel no cold, and by night you are swift and strong.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.gift.3: You sleep only in a coffin, but a coffin lets you sleep by day as well as by night. Keep captives in Iron Maidens beside it, and you wake healed and fed. A Blood Throne siphons them while you sit.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.gift.4: Strike a vampire player, and every vampire near comes to their aid.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.gift.5: The Plague, the Miasma and rabies cannot touch you.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.gift.6: Most of all: you have the blood skills, worn in your skill slots and cast with their keys, paid for in blood.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.1: The sun burns you. A helmet takes the burning in your stead, until it breaks; shade, rain and water save you.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.2: Garlic: hung braids sicken you if you come near, its potion weakens your blows and slows you, and you cannot bring yourself to eat or drink it.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.3: Holy water burns you with a fire water cannot quench, and breaks whatever skills you have running.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.4: Silver bites deep. A silvered weapon's wound stops your healing and your blood coming back for a while.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.5: Hunters attack you on sight, and some healers will have no dealings with your kind.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.6: Beds are lost to you: only a coffin will do.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.curse.7: Death costs you: you rise again, but ten days of your age are lost.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.intro: Every ten days you survive, your powers grow. Death sets you back ten days.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.tier.1: Day 10, %s: skills 5% cheaper, 110 blood (36 back on its own), 4 more health, always swift.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.tier.2: Day 20, %s: skills 10% cheaper, 150 blood (60 back on its own), 7 more health, swift, quick-handed and strong.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.tier.3: Day 30, %s: skills 20% cheaper, 200 blood (90 back on its own), 30 health in all, swifter and stronger still.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.more.1: Last Stand: an Ancient brought to half health is shielded by the Armor of the Ancient and starts to heal, unbidden. It cannot happen again for two minutes.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.more.2: An Ancient is known to the night: much of what prowls in it will let you pass, and some of it will even fight at your side.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.age.more.3: Your age shows above your blood bar, and on the Blood Skills screen.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.builds.1: Skills can be worn in four slots. Some ways to wear them:
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.builds.2: The Stalker: Stalker's Gaze to find your prey through walls, Dash to close on it, Blood Spear to pin it to the wall.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.builds.3: The Fortress: Armor of Ancient, Defy Death and Daywalker. Hard to kill, by day or night.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.builds.4: The Swarm Lord: Bat Swarm, Death March and Night of Terror. Let the night fight for you.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.builds.5: The Phantom: Shadow Step, Ephemeral Sword and Possess. Never where they expect you.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.souls.1: A blood skill must be unlocked before its tome can be found or read. Unlocking takes souls.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.souls.2: A soul is a restless spirit of the dead, caught in a bottle. A Silvered Bottle holds one at peace; a plain glass bottle crams one in, in torment. Either will do. Where the dead do not rest, look for them.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.souls.3: Stand near an Ancient Translator with your souls, open the Blood Skills chapter, and choose a skill to unlock. The translator takes the souls: one for a Neo skill, two for Unusual, three for Ancient.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.souls.4: Neo skills come first. Unlock two Neo skills to open the Unusual ones, and two Unusual skills to open the Ancient.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.souls.5: Once a skill is unlocked, its Ancient Tome can turn up in the world. Bring it to an Ancient Translator fed by Iron Maidens with captives inside, and it will read the tome and give you the skill.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.souls.6: When the translation is done, the skill's page in this book is written in full.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skills.intro: Choose a skill to learn of it, or to unlock it. Souls you carry: %s.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skill.upgrad: Upgrade it at a Blood Altar for 5 Tokens of Blood and a Token of Master. Upgraded, it costs %s more blood.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skill.unlock: Unlocked, but not yet read. Find its tome.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skill.transl: Bring the tome to an Ancient Translator fed by Iron Maidens. Fed by one, it takes %s minutes; more maidens read it faster.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skill.locked: Locked. Unlocking it takes %s souls, at an Ancient Translator.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skill.at_tra: The translator is near. Souls you carry: %s of %s.
guide.crimsoncovenant.codex.skill.go_to_: Stand near an Ancient Translator to unlock it. Souls you carry: %s of %s.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.vampire: The undead of the blood, pale and red-eyed. They prey on the living by night and burn by day, and their kill leaves the curse behind.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.master_va: Lords of their kind, who walk abroad under the Blood Moon with a court of bats and thralls. They answer to no one, and carry ancient tomes.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.vampire_b: Cave-dwelling bats of the vampires' kind. They nip, and they drink, and many carry rabies.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.hunter: The hunters of the night, armed with silver and fire. They come in parties led by a banner-bearer, and will take a recruit who brings a Silver Coin.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.hunter_ch: A hunter who fights with potions: garlic, holy water and worse.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.master_hu: The deadliest of the hunters, abroad under the Blood Moon, armed with everything the order has.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.werewolf: A beast of the full moon, gone by moonset. Silver is its bane. Slain, it may leave a tooth, which brews into a Potion of Frenzy, or its hide, which plaits into whips and makes a belt that lets its wearer run with the moon.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.ghost: Restless dead that drift through walls and swoop through the living. Only holy water harms them; a bottle can catch them, and their souls are worth much to vampires.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.headless_: A rider without a head and with a golden spear. Set a jack o'lantern down by night beside a Crooked Tree, deep in the woods, and he takes it for his head and comes riding up the road. He rides you down, strikes, wheels away and comes again, now and then blinding whoever he hits, and lobs burning pumpkins that throw you off your feet. He won't charge through lingering holy water. Kill his horse and he fights on foot, but it claws its way back up out of the ground by his tree before long. Slain, he rises as the Spirit of Halloween.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.halloween: What rises from the slain Horseman, up out of his Crooked Tree: a headless thing of bone and grave cloth, its ribs broken out through its shroud, drifting through walls after his horse. If it reaches the horse, he rides again; kill the horse and the spirit must wait by the tree for it to dig its way back out. Nothing touches it but holy water, and it takes three splashes to banish it, when at last it gives up his head, pickled in a jar. Set on a pike, that head keeps monsters fifty blocks off, and calls his ghost to ride guard by night.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.rat: Vermin of the villages: they burrow in, raid the crops and stores by night, and bring the Miasma when there are too many. Many carry rabies.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.plague_do: A beaked healer who comes when the Miasma falls. He cures the Plague for emeralds, and sells the Potion of Cleanse, which cures Hydrophobia and, drunk, draws out the vampire's curse before it takes hold.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.cathedral: A guardian of silver-veined stone, woken by a hunter to stand watch. It turns to stone in the sun.
guide.crimsoncovenant.bestiary.blood_gar: A guardian of blood-dark stone, woken by a vampire to stand watch. It turns to stone in the sun.
